name: nihontekini
description: Connect Nihontekini Japanese vocabulary decks, spaced repetition and quizzes to ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Create and manage Japanese vocabulary flashcards in Nihontekini from ChatGPT. Build decks from a topic, JLPT level or text, look up and explain words, fix or suspend cards, check your learning progress and practice the words you keep forgetting with personalized quizzes. Cards include readings, English meanings, explanations and example sentences, and sync to the Nihontekini iOS app. Connect your Nihontekini account to start.
defaultPrompt: Add 20 N5 food words to a Kitchen deck.
Quiz me on the Japanese words I keep forgetting.
How am I doing with my Japanese this week?

positive.prompt: Add 20 N5 food words to a deck called Kitchen.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates or reuses the Kitchen deck, adds N5 food words with kana readings and English-only meanings, and reports how many cards were added or skipped.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on the Japanese words I keep forgetting.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks one question at a time without revealing the answer, records the answers and summarizes the score.

positive.prompt: How am I doing with my Japanese this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes reviews done and due, words learned and the weakest words, using only returned data.

positive.prompt: Fix the reading of 今日 in my cards, it should be きょう.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the user's own 今日 card, sets the reading to きょう and confirms the change.

positive.prompt: I already know ありがとう, stop showing it to me.
positive.expected_behavior: Suspends the matching card and says it will no longer appear in reviews.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not use the plugin
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tokyo today?

negative.description: Bulk delete must ask for confirmation first
No access to other people's data

publication.release_notes: Skills no longer mention account limits.
